fixes.find: Take 3 from both sides to get $0$ on the right.
fixes.replace: Move every term to the right-hand side so the $\sin^2\theta$ term is positive, leaving $0$ on the left; write it with $0$ on the right.
fixes.why: Subtracting 3 from both sides gives -2sin^2+3sin-1=0, not the line shown; the shown line comes from moving terms to the other side.
